answer: An identity earns its seat through Licensed sewer cleaner roster with water utility verification, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the anchor up to the light, weigh the crystal of the attack, and keep the saffron of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
